title: Check RMS is up and running and verify SQL Server Agent is running (post-unplanned restart sanity check)
summary: Perform a post-unplanned restart sanity check by confirming RMS is up and running and verifying that the SQL Server Agent service is running in SQL Server Configuration Manager on the WCS backup server. This check is motivated by a prior issue where jobs were not cleaning up after an unplanned restart.
when_to_use: Use after an unplanned restart as a final sanity check to ensure RMS is up/running and SQL Server Agent is running (to reduce risk of follow-on issues such as jobs not cleaning up).
not_for: Do not proceed with further RMS/job health assumptions if RMS is not up/running or if SQL Server Agent is not running; stop and escalate per source guidance.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the RMS up/running check and verify SQL Server Agent service state in SQL Server Configuration Manager on the WCS backup server.
access_or_tools_needed: SQL Server Agent service status visibility

access_required: Access to SQL Server Configuration Manager on the server
system_preconditions: An unplanned restart has occurred and a final sanity check is required

visual_references.description: Training video frame showing the post-unplanned restart check: check RMS up/running and verify SQL Server Configuration Manager shows SQL Server Agent running; includes the RDP target host name.

steps.title: Check RMS to make sure everything's up and running
steps.purpose: Confirm the RMS environment is operational as part of the post-unplanned restart sanity check.
steps.instruction: Using RMS access, check the RMS system status/dashboard to confirm RMS is up and running.
steps.expected_result: RMS indicates the system is up and running.
steps.healthy_condition: RMS status reflects an up/running state (no indication that RMS is down/not running).

actions.label: Verify RMS up/running
actions.exact_action: Check RMS to make sure everything's up and running.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if RMS does not appear up/running.

steps.title: Verify that the SQL Server Agent service is running
steps.purpose: Ensure SQL Server Agent is running as part of the post-unplanned restart sanity check.
steps.instruction: In SQL Server Configuration Manager, verify the SQL Server Agent service state is Running.
steps.expected_result: SQL Server Configuration Manager shows SQL Server Agent is running.
steps.healthy_condition: SQL Server Agent service state is Running in SQL Server Configuration Manager.
steps.failure_condition: SQL Server Agent service is not running.
